objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Finish the WordPress install, then make the password reset mail's sender address run a command, and read /ctf/flag.
hints: Finish the install with an admin user, as Vulhub's guide does. WordPress builds the sender address of a password reset mail from a request header. Read the PwnScriptum advisory (CVE-2016-10033).
The address reaches the sendmail command line of the mail transfer agent (Exim). The flag is at /ctf/flag on the web machine.

steps.title: Find the component
steps.prompt: Which mail library inside WordPress is vulnerable? (name)

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which HTTP request header does WordPress use to build the sender address? (header name)
